host_baseline.basis: measured once with the pinned host and a role's structured-output tool (athena.toml [agents]); not measured per invocation

input.basis: Claude Code result.modelUsage for the requested model

output.basis: Claude Code result.modelUsage for the requested model

cache_read.basis: Claude Code result.modelUsage for the requested model

cache_write.basis: Claude Code result.modelUsage for the requested model

cost.basis: Claude Code total_cost_usd, at list price

commands_run: cargo fmt --all && cargo test -p athena-data escalated 2>&1 && cargo test -p athena-core planner_effort 2>&1
cargo fmt --all && cargo test -p athena-cli --test backtest --test ontology --test budgets --test mirrors --test job_plan 2>&1 ; cargo test -p xtask --test spec --test policy 2>&1
cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings 2>&1 ; cargo test -p athena-data -p athena-core -q 2>&1; cargo fmt --all --check

policy_denials.detail: grep -n "planner_effort\|verifier_effort\|^\[models\]" athena.toml | head; grep -n "athena.toml" crates/athena-core/src/run/tests.rs | head
cargo fmt --all && cargo test -p athena-data escalated 2>&1 | tail -15 && cargo test -p athena-core planner_effort 2>&1 | tail -30
git diff --stat -- CHANGELOG.md && tail -c 300 docs/decision-links.toml | cat -A | head -30

cargo fmt --all && cargo test -p athena-cli --test backtest --test ontology --test budgets --test mirrors --test job_plan 2>&1 | grep -E "^test result|FAILED|failed|panicked|Running" ; cargo test -p xtask --test spec --test policy 2>&1 | grep -E "^test result|FAILED|failed|panicked|Running|rejected"
cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings 2>&1 ; cargo test -p athena-data -p athena-core 2>&1 | awk '/^test result|FAILED|panicked/'; cargo fmt --all --check && echo FMT_OK
cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings 2>&1 ; cargo test -p athena-data -p athena-core -q 2>&1; cargo fmt --all --check && echo FMT_OK
